test_title: PYST 09: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in Direct to Indirect Speech.

She said, "I was tired."

options.text: She said that she will be tired.
She said that she was tired.
She said that she is tired.
She said that she had been tired

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] ** __Key Points__ ** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in **Direct Speech**: *She said, "I was tired."* 
 
• When converting Direct Speech to Indirect Speech, the pronoun **"I"** changes to **"she"**. 
 
• Since the reporting verb **"said"** is in the past tense, the verb in the reported clause undergoes **backshifting**. 
 
• The past tense **"was"** can shift to **past perfect ("had been")** to clearly indicate an action completed before the time of reporting. 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**. 

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"She said that she had been tired."* 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] ** Additional Information__ ** 

 
• **Option 1:** Incorrect — tense changes incorrectly to future. 
 
• **Option 2:** Grammatically acceptable but does not reflect tense backshifting beyond past. 
 
• **Option 3:** Incorrect — present tense is not used after a past reporting verb.
